override_replaces: Candidate abstract composite: incessant or recurrent pericarditis, 20/120 vs 45/120.
override_with: Declared absent/refused for recurrence-specific outcome; source does not provide recurrence-only extraction.
stated_reason: ELIGIBLE under the registered broad PICO (population is pericarditis — ACUTE first episode OR recurrent — treated to prevent recurrence; the protocol was deliberately revised from a recurrent-only draft), so ICAP is NOT refused for population. It is not POOLED because its recurrence-specific outcome is not extractable from an accessible source: the ICAP abstract (NEJM 2013, PMID 23992557) reports only the composite primary “incessant OR recurrent pericarditis” (20/120 vs 45/120), a DIFFERENT endpoint from our “recurrent pericarditis” outcome; the pure-recurrence component (reported as 11/120 vs 25/120 in the full text per an external audit) is full-text-only and the NEJM full text is NOT open-access (no PMC/EPMC, Europe PMC isOpenAccess=N), so we cannot verify it against a committed source span and do not pool an unverifiable number. Were it poolable it would give k=3, RR ~0.474, excluding the null — consistent with a later randomised-evidence meta (RR 0.48, 0.36–0.63) and with our k=2 point estimate. Recorded as not-extracted (full text not retrievable), not a population refusal.
general_rule: A composite that contains the target component must not be pooled as the target component unless the target component is separately reported.
judgement: General harness rule, not a one-off: composite containment and accessible-source absence should be enforced for any topic.

override_replaces: Abstract 4-point TECOS composite HR 0.98 (CV death, MI, stroke, or unstable-angina hospitalization).
override_with: Declared absent/refused for 3-point MACE because the 3-point value is not in the committed abstract.
stated_reason: declared absent (estimand mismatch): TECOS's abstract reports its primary as a FOUR-point composite (cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke, OR hospitalization for unstable angina), HR 0.98 (0.88-1.09). Our outcome is 3-point MACE (no unstable-angina hospitalization); TECOS's 3-point HR (~0.99) is not in the committed abstract (full text/supplement only). Refuse rather than pool a 4-point estimate under a 3-point label. Surfaced by cross-family (Fable) QA on a page that had passed every internal gate.
general_rule: A 4-point composite must not be pooled under a 3-point MACE label when the added component changes the endpoint.
judgement: General harness rule: composite definitions must match before pooling; otherwise the trial is a refusal/absence state.

override_replaces: Extractor absence or failure to select CARMELINA's 3-point MACE primary HR.
override_with: Reported 3-point MACE HR 1.02 (95% CI 0.89-1.17).
stated_reason: PubMed abstract (PMID 30418475): During a median follow-up of 2.2 years, the primary outcome occurred in 434 of 3494 (12.4%) and 420 of 3485 (12.1%) in the linagliptin and placebo groups, respectively, (absolute incidence rate difference, 0.13 [95% CI, -0.63 to 0.90] per 100 person-years) (HR, 1.02; 95% CI, 0.89-1.17; P < .001 for noninferiority). CARMELINA primary is 3-point MACE (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke).
general_rule: When a trial defines the target composite and reports its HR, the extractor should bind that endpoint even in noninferiority wording.
judgement: General harness rule: endpoint-definition sentences and reported effect measures should be parsed across noninferiority abstracts.

override_replaces: Count-derived RR about 0.84 from 504/2833 vs 600/2841.
override_with: Reported time-to-event HR 0.82 (95% CI 0.73-0.93).
stated_reason: FIDELIO-DKD (PMID 33264825) abstract: 'a primary outcome event occurred in 504 of 2833 patients (17.8%) in the finerenone group and 600 of 2841 patients (21.1%) in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.82; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.73 to 0.93; P=0.001)'. SCALE CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor pooled the count-derived RR (0.84) from 504/2833 vs 600/2841, creating a mixed HR/RR pool with FIGARO's HR; the trial reports the time-to-event HR 0.82 directly, which is the correct like-for-like estimand.
general_rule: For an HR-family outcome, a directly reported HR beats a count-derived RR from the same sentence.
judgement: General harness rule: reported effect measure should control the pool scale; do not mix RR into HR pools.

override_replaces: Abstract-path absence/factorial refusal for SU.FOL.OM3 omega-3 effect.
override_with: Full-text omega-3 marginal main-effect HR 1.08 (95% CI 0.79-1.47), collapsed over B-vitamin allocation.
stated_reason: SU.FOL.OM3 (PMID 21115589) full text (PMC2993045, Results / fig 4): 'Allocation to omega 3 fatty acids was not associated with any significant effect on major vascular events (81 v 76 patients, hazard ratio 1.08 (0.79 to 1.47), P=0.64; fig 4).' This is the omega-3 MAIN-EFFECT MARGINAL (omega-3 present vs absent, collapsed over the 2x2 B-vitamin allocation) on the trial's declared primary outcome (major cardiovascular events). Double-blind, placebo-controlled factorial; 2501 patients with a history of myocardial infarction, unstable angina, or ischaemic stroke (secondary prevention). Estimand-matched: major vascular events, HR, intention-to-treat, trial end.
general_rule: A 2x2 factorial trial may contribute the target factor's marginal main effect when the committed source explicitly reports that factor and endpoint.
judgement: General harness rule: factorial designs need factor binding, not blanket refusal when a target-factor marginal effect is available.

override_replaces: Wrong abstract primary endpoint: cardiovascular-death HR 0.98.
override_with: Target MACE/major vascular events HR 1.01 (95% CI 0.93-1.10).
stated_reason: ORIGIN (PMID 22686415) abstract: 'The use of n-3 fatty acids also had no significant effect on the rates of major vascular events (1034 patients [16.5%] vs. 1017 patients [16.3%]; hazard ratio, 1.01; 95% CI, 0.93 to 1.10; P=0.81)'. ENDPOINT CORRECTION (override): the abstract's stated PRIMARY outcome is 'death from cardiovascular causes' (HR 0.98), which is NOT our outcome; the abstract's MAJOR VASCULAR EVENTS result (our MACE endpoint) is HR 1.01. The generic 'primary outcome' keyword matched ORIGIN's CV-death primary sentence (appearing first), pooling the wrong endpoint; this override pins the correct major-vascular-events value.
general_rule: Generic primary-outcome anchors must be disabled when the trial primary is not the review outcome and a separate target endpoint is reported.
judgement: General harness rule: outcome identity beats generic primary-outcome wording.

override_replaces: Rischio e Prevenzione revised broad composite counts 733/6239 vs 745/6266.
override_with: Declared absent/refused for 3-point major vascular events.
stated_reason: declared absent (definition mismatch, cross-family definition audit): the stored 733/6239 vs 745/6266 is Rischio e Prevenzione's REVISED primary endpoint 'death from cardiovascular causes or admission to hospital for cardiovascular causes' (a broad CV-death-or-hospitalization composite), NOT the 3-point major-vascular-events (death/MI/stroke) our outcome names. The abstract states the INITIALLY specified 3-point primary was revised after a lower-than-expected event rate; the 3-point counts are not in the abstract. Refuse rather than pool a broader CV-hospitalization composite under a major-vascular-events label.
general_rule: A revised broad composite cannot substitute for the originally named 3-point endpoint when the 3-point counts are absent.
judgement: General harness rule: endpoint-definition drift within a trial must be represented as incompatibility, not pooled silently.

override_replaces: OMEGA-REMODEL idiosyncratic MACE HR 1.014 for a composite lacking stroke/CV-death.
override_with: Declared absent/refused for death/MI/stroke major vascular events.
stated_reason: declared absent (definition mismatch, cross-family definition audit): OMEGA-REMODEL's MACE is an idiosyncratic composite (all-cause death, heart-failure hospitalization, recurrent acute coronary syndrome, late CABG) with NO stroke and NO cardiovascular-death component, in a 6-month post-AMI cardiac-remodeling pilot -- not the death/MI/stroke major-vascular-events endpoint our outcome names. Refuse rather than pool a different composite under a MACE label.
general_rule: A label such as MACE is insufficient; component definitions must match the review endpoint.
judgement: General harness rule: acronym-only endpoint matching is unsafe across topics.

override_replaces: Per-protocol/completer RR about 0.21 from 63 patients who completed according to protocol.
override_with: Declared absent/refused because randomized-denominator ITT AAD is not in the abstract.
stated_reason: declared absent (population mismatch, cross-family definition audit): the stored RR 0.21 is a PER-PROTOCOL analysis of the 63 patients who 'completed the study according to the protocol', not the 87 randomized (46 vs 41). An ITT/randomized-denominator AAD result is not in the abstract. Refuse rather than pool a per-protocol effect where the other trials are ITT.
general_rule: Observed-case or per-protocol effects must not be pooled as ITT/randomized-denominator effects.
judgement: General harness rule: analysis set belongs in the compatibility key and refusal ontology.

override_replaces: Completer counts 16/106 vs 13/98 among 204 follow-up completers.
override_with: Declared absent/refused because ITT AAD among 275 randomized is not in the abstract.
stated_reason: declared absent (population mismatch, cross-family definition audit): the stored 16/106 vs 13/98 are the 204 patients who COMPLETED follow-up, not the 275 randomized (~26% excluded). An ITT/randomized-denominator AAD result is not in the abstract. Refuse rather than pool a completers analysis where the other trials are ITT.
general_rule: Completer denominators must not be silently substituted for randomized denominators.
judgement: General harness rule: denominator provenance and analysis set should be checked before pooling.

override_replaces: 14-day AAD RR 0.47 selected from a multi-timepoint abstract.
override_with: Study-end 56-day AAD RR 0.46 (95% CI 0.30-0.69).
stated_reason: L. reuteri trial (PMID 40488914) abstract: primary endpoint AAD 'at 14 days (7.9% vs. 16.7%; RR: 0.47, 95%CI 0.30-0.7); at 21 days ... RR: 0.49; and at 56 days (9.1% vs. 19.6%; RR: 0.46, 95%CI 0.30-0.69)'. TIMEPOINT CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor took the 14-day RR 0.47; the study-end (56-day) AAD result is RR 0.46 (0.30-0.69), the timepoint consistent with the other trials' end-of-follow-up AAD.
general_rule: When multiple target-outcome timepoints are reported, choose the configured study-end/follow-up timepoint consistently or refuse.
judgement: General harness rule: timepoint is a compatibility dimension and should not be left to first-match extraction.

outcome: Composite cardiovascular death or heart-failure hospitalization
override_replaces: Count-derived RR about 0.823 from 914/4187 vs 1117/4212.
override_with: Reported time-to-event HR 0.80 (95% CI 0.73-0.87).
stated_reason: PARADIGM-HF (PMID 25176015) abstract: the primary composite of death from cardiovascular causes or hospitalization for heart failure occurred in 914 of 4187 (21.8%) LCZ696 vs 1117 of 4212 (26.5%) enalapril patients (hazard ratio in the LCZ696 group, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.73 to 0.87; P<0.001). SCALE CORRECTION (override): the CT.gov structured extractor pooled the count-derived RR 0.823 from 914/4187 vs 1117/4212 and labelled the k=1 pool HR; the trial reports the time-to-event HR 0.80 directly.
general_rule: For time-to-event outcomes, directly reported HRs should not be replaced by event-count RRs.
judgement: General harness rule: structured counts corroborate but should not override the declared HR estimand.

override_replaces: Overall adverse-event counts 141/161 vs 61/81 misfiled as gastrointestinal adverse events.
override_with: Declared absent/refused for GI-specific adverse events because no GI numerator/denominator is stated.
stated_reason: declared absent (override): the STEP-12 (China/Taiwan) abstract reports OVERALL adverse events ('Adverse events were reported in 141 [87.6%] of 161 ... and 61 [75.3%] of 81 ...'), with gastrointestinal disorders only named as the most common CATEGORY. It gives no gastrointestinal-specific event count, so the 141/161 vs 61/81 extracted for this harm outcome is a wrong-endpoint (overall AEs, not GI AEs). Refuse rather than pool the wrong endpoint. Surfaced by the cycle-76 blind accuracy census (a wrong number that passed every gate).
general_rule: Generic any-adverse-event counts must not be pooled under a specific harm category without category-specific numerators.
judgement: General harness rule: specific harm outcomes need discriminating keywords and endpoint-specific numbers.

outcome: Trial-defined major kidney / cardiorenal composite (components differ by trial)
override_replaces: Count-derived RR from 197/2152 vs 312/2152.
override_with: Reported kidney-composite HR 0.61 (95% CI 0.51-0.72).
stated_reason: DAPA-CKD (PMID 32970396) abstract: primary composite (sustained >=50% eGFR decline, ESKD, or renal/CV death) 197/2152 dapagliflozin vs 312/2152 placebo (hazard ratio, 0.61; 95% CI, 0.51 to 0.72; P<0.001). SCALE CORRECTION (override): the CT.gov/abstract count extractor pooled a count-derived RR into the HR pool; the trial reports the kidney-composite HR 0.61 directly.
general_rule: A reported HR for a kidney-composite time-to-event endpoint beats a count-derived RR.
judgement: General harness rule: scale coherence should be automatic across HR-family kidney outcome pools.

outcome: Trial-defined major kidney / cardiorenal composite (components differ by trial)
override_replaces: Count-derived RR from EMPA-KIDNEY event counts.
override_with: Reported kidney-composite HR 0.72 (95% CI 0.64-0.82).
stated_reason: EMPA-KIDNEY (PMID 36331190) abstract: primary composite (kidney disease progression or CV death) in empagliflozin vs 558/3305 (16.9%) placebo (hazard ratio, 0.72; 95% CI, 0.64 to 0.82; P<0.001). SCALE CORRECTION (override): pool the reported kidney-composite HR, not the count-derived RR.
general_rule: Use the reported HR when the target endpoint is analyzed as time to event.
judgement: General harness rule: reported time-to-event scale must control the pooled estimand.

override_replaces: Absence or parent-trial extraction that did not expose hospitalized heart failure alone.
override_with: Committed full-text HHF HR 0.65 (95% CI 0.50-0.85).
stated_reason: cache/sglt2-primary-prevention-hf/pmc_26819227_fulltext.txt (PMID 26819227): As previously reported, hospitalization for heart failure occurred in a significantly lower percentage of patients treated with empagliflozin [126/4687 patients (2.7%)] than with placebo [95/2333 patients (4.1%)] [HR: 0.65 (95% CI: 0.50–0.85); P = 0.002]
general_rule: Committed full-text/source records can supply a target secondary endpoint when trial binding and endpoint identity are explicit.
judgement: General harness rule: secondary endpoint recovery should be source-backed, not trial-specific override data.

override_replaces: Absence or composite CV-death/HHF source value for CANVAS.
override_with: Committed source-record hospitalized-HF-alone HR 0.67 (95% CI 0.52-0.87).
stated_reason: cache/sglt2-primary-prevention-hf/records.json hhf_source_records PMID 29526832 abstract: Overall, cardiovascular death or hospitalized HF was reduced in those treated with canagliflozin compared with placebo (16.3 versus 20.8 per 1000 patient-years; hazard ratio [HR], 0.78; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.67-0.91), as was fatal or hospitalized HF (HR, 0.70; 95% CI, 0.55-0.89) and hospitalized HF alone (HR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.52-0.87)
general_rule: Linked source records for a trial-specific secondary endpoint should be first-class extraction inputs with trial binding.
judgement: General harness rule: a linked outcome-specific source should not require an override when committed and identifiable.

override_replaces: Composite or absence from DECLARE-TIMI 58 wording.
override_with: Hospitalization-for-heart-failure component HR 0.73 (95% CI 0.61-0.88).
stated_reason: cache/sglt2-primary-prevention-hf/records.json records PMID 30415602 abstract: which reflected a lower rate of hospitalization for heart failure (hazard ratio, 0.73; 95% CI, 0.61 to 0.88)
general_rule: When a sentence explicitly reports the target component after a broader composite, the component effect should be extracted, not the composite.
judgement: General harness rule: component-vs-composite extraction should be label-bound within the sentence.

override_replaces: Absence or broader VERTIS-CV source outcome.
override_with: First hospitalized-heart-failure HR 0.70 (95% CI 0.54-0.90).
stated_reason: cache/sglt2-primary-prevention-hf/records.json hhf_source_records PMID 33026243 abstract: Overall, ertugliflozin reduced risk for first HHF (HR, 0.70 [95% CI, 0.54-0.90]; P=0.006)
general_rule: Outcome-specific secondary publications/records linked to a parent trial should feed the extractor when the endpoint matches.
judgement: General harness rule: target secondary endpoints need committed source-record plumbing, not one-off overrides.

override_replaces: CT.gov single-pair or refusal path for a 3-arm dose trial with shared placebo.
override_with: Combined esketamine arms: mean -18.91, SD 13.95, n=209 vs placebo mean -14.8, SD 15.07, n=108.
stated_reason: TRANSFORM-1 (NCT02417064) committed CT.gov MADRS Day-28 (MMRM) per-arm change scores: intranasal esketamine 56 mg + oral AD -19.0 (SD 13.86, n=111); 84 mg + oral AD -18.8 (SD 14.12, n=98); oral AD + intranasal placebo -14.8 (SD 15.07, n=108). MULTI-ARM COMBINATION (Cochrane RevMan 6.5.2.10): the two intranasal esketamine dose arms are combined against the SHARED placebo to avoid double-counting it: combined esketamine mean -18.91, SD 13.95, n=209 (weighted mean of -19.0/-18.8; pooled SD from (n1-1)s1^2+(n2-1)s2^2 + n1*n2/(n1+n2)*(m1-m2)^2 over N-1). Both dose arms are INTRANASAL (route matches the protocol intranasal PICO). vs placebo -14.8 (SD 15.07, n=108). MD = -4.11.
general_rule: Multiple eligible dose arms sharing a comparator should be combined by the standard formula before pooling continuous outcomes.
judgement: General harness rule: RevMan-style multi-arm combination should be automated for any continuous multi-dose trial.

override_replaces: Any-diarrhoea counts 9/119 vs 29/127 or RR 0.3.
override_with: AAD-specific counts 4/119 vs 22/127.
stated_reason: Can 2006 (PMID 15740542) abstract: 'S. boulardii also reduced the risk of antibiotic-associated diarrhoea ... [four of 119 (3.4%) vs. 22 of 127 (17.3%), relative risk: 0.2; 95% confidence interval: 0.07-0.5]'. ENDPOINT CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor took the trial's ANY-diarrhoea figure (9/119 vs 29/127, RR 0.3) but our outcome is ANTIBIOTIC-ASSOCIATED diarrhoea, which the same abstract reports separately as 4/119 vs 22/127 (RR 0.2).
general_rule: A broader any-diarrhoea endpoint must not be used for antibiotic-associated diarrhoea when AAD-specific counts are reported.
judgement: General harness rule: target endpoint terms should bind counts more strongly than broader family terms.

override_replaces: Source OR 0.34 was selected into an RR-family count pool.
override_with: Per-arm AAD counts 7/44 vs 16/45, yielding count RR about 0.447.
stated_reason: Beausoleil 2007 (PMID 18026577) abstract: 'antibiotic-associated diarrhea occurred in seven of 44 patients (15.9%) in the lactobacilli group and in 16 of 45 patients (35.6%) in the placebo group (OR 0.34, 95% CI 0.125 to 0.944)'. SCALE CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor pooled the source ODDS RATIO 0.34 into this RR-family pool; the per-arm counts give the count-based RR directly, consistent with the other count-based trials.
general_rule: When an RR-family arm-count pool is required and counts are available, compute RR from counts rather than pooling a reported OR.
judgement: General harness rule: OR and RR scales should not be mixed silently when arm counts permit the target scale.

override_replaces: Synthesized hyperkalemia counts 161/1367 vs 99/1376 or wrong CT.gov hospitalization endpoint.
override_with: Declared absent/refused: abstract reports only percentages (11.8% vs 7.2%) and no verified denominators for serum K+ >5.5.
stated_reason: hyperkalemia (serum K+ >5.5) is reported in the EMPHASIS-HF abstract ONLY as percentages (11.8% eplerenone vs 7.2% placebo) with NO per-arm denominator, and the full text is not open-access; the CT.gov structured field is the WRONG endpoint (hospitalization due to hyperkalemia, 4/1367). Percentages alone are insufficient under the extraction policy: the earlier counts 161/1367 vs 99/1376 were synthesized as % x an unverified denominator (they sum to 2743 != the trial's randomised 2737) and were wrongly badged aact_verified. A % x denominator synthesis is harness-reconstructed, never source-verified, so it must not be pooled. Declared absent rather than pool a fabricated count/CI.
general_rule: Percentages alone are insufficient for arm-count extraction unless denominators are source-backed and endpoint-matched; registry counts for a different endpoint must not fill the gap.
judgement: General harness rule: denominator and endpoint provenance must both validate before deriving counts from percentages.

override_replaces: Extractor absence caused by the hand-named VESALIUS-CV record being absent from the topic cache before the external audit recovery.
override_with: Published prespecified 3-point MACE HR 0.75 (95% CI 0.65-0.86), with the alternative 4-point co-primary HR 0.81 (0.73-0.89) rendered as sensitivity.
stated_reason: Protocol amendment 2026-09-16 selects the prespecified co-primary closest to canonical 3-point MACE by component set, not by result; both co-primary results were known from the committed abstract and the alternative is disclosed.
rule_group: Endpoint identity and co-primary endpoint selection
general_rule: When multiple prespecified primary MACE definitions exist, choose the component set closest to the registered canonical endpoint and disclose alternatives as sensitivities.
judgement: General endpoint-selection rule plus source-verified override; not a one-off numeric repair.

override_replaces: Potential extraction of ODYSSEY LONG TERM post hoc MACE HR as though it were a prespecified poolable endpoint.

stated_reason: The committed abstract explicitly labels the MACE analysis post hoc; P/I/C/design eligibility is retained, but post-hoc outcome evidence is not pooled as the registered endpoint.
general_rule: A post hoc outcome effect must be declared absent/not pooled for the registered prespecified outcome unless the protocol permits post hoc pooling.
judgement: General prespecification rule with a committed-source absence state.

override_replaces: Potential surrogate-outcome extraction from GLAGOV as though it reported MACE.

judgement: General outcome-availability rule with committed-source absence state.
